refers_to: plant (Electric Generating Plant, Fermi Equipment Holdco, LLC air permit application)
page: Notice of Receipt of Application and Intent to Obtain Air Permit, permit 181009 (notice issuance date August 5, 2025), location paragraph and map link
notes: Coordinates appear only in the TCEQ map link, printed longitude first then latitude; the notice says the link is 'provided as a public courtesy and not part of the application or notice. For exact location, refer to application.' The same notice describes the 'Electric Generating Plant located approximately 15 miles northeast of Amarillo, along US Highway 60, near intersection of US Highway 60 and Farm-to-Market Road 2373 on north side of the road., Amarillo, Carson County, Texas 79101'. No street address given. The Texas Register of July 24, 2026 (51 TexReg 4947-4949, https://www.sos.state.tx.us/texreg/pdf/backview/0724/0724ia.pdf) carries a TCEQ notice for Fermi Equipment Holdco permits 183462, PSDTX1704 and GHGPSDTX271 with the same description and the same map link. The applicant address 620 South Taylor Street, Suite 301, Amarillo is a mailing address, not the site. Fermi America's NRC combined license application (https://www.nrc.gov/docs/ML2516/ML25169A396.pdf, Part 3 section 2.1) places the nuclear units on the same campus 'approximately 17 miles northeast of the City of Amarillo, in Carson County, Texas', bounded by US Highway 60 (south), FM 683 (west) and FM 2373 (east), adjacent to the Pantex Plant; no coordinates found there. These records concern the power plant on the campus; a record for the data centre building itself was not found.

The listed MLGW update (https://www.mlgw.com/images/content/files/pdf/new/5-5-25%20xAI%20Update.pdf, section 'Background of Utility Support for xAI') describes it as 'a second large facility located on Tulane Rd very near the TN/MS state line', with 'a very large TVA/MLGW substation just west of the facility'. No coordinates in either document; one further search for a Shelby County Health Department permit record of the site found none.
